title: territory catalog row
description: One row for one material (a species, a mineral, or a knowledge) catalogued for a place in the Turtle Island taxonomy, per the hopeium capability specification's territory catalog (ii). A thin allOf profile over Cistern's resource-row.schema.json (the base is never copied): every catalog row is a resource row first (identity.kind 'commodity' or 'scarce-input', identity.issuer the territory's holder or 'unknown', the two-witness witnesses/provenance blocks), profiled with the taxonomy place, the material's identity, its known products and markets, the chain position the place currently holds, and the benefit-sharing record its holder's row enters under, if any. A row that names a holder in identity.issuer (anything other than 'unknown') and carries no benefitSharingRecord is invalid: the catalog never names a holder without a benefit-sharing record. Neither this schema nor the base closes its top-level object (json-schema-services-section's bounded evaluator does not implement unevaluatedProperties, the standard keyword an allOf composition needs to close itself without duplicating the other branch's field names; see the 2026-09-06 admitted friction on this schema and on the base). Every nested object this profile declares (territory, material, each knownProducts/markets item) is fully closed with additionalProperties:false.

territory.description: The taxonomy node this material is catalogued for.

path.description: The taxonomy node's repo-relative path under turtle-island-ecological-adaptation-services.

plainName.description: The node's plain place name (e.g. 'North Shore', 'Lake Superior').

scientificName.description: The accepted scientific name (a species binomial), or null when the material is a mineral or a knowledge with no such name.

materialKind.description: species: a living organism; mineral: a non-living geological material; knowledge: a practice or form held rather than grown or mined.

knownProducts.description: The material's known products and uses, each cited to a first-party source.

markets.description: Known buyers or market channels for the material or its products, each cited to a first-party source.

kind.description: What kind of buyer or channel this is (a reference-implementation cooperative, a state regulator's licensed harvest market, a wholesaler, 'unknown').

chainPositionHeld.description: The chain position (per territorial-economy-science-services-section's chain-position term) the place currently holds for this material, with a one-sentence evidence label, or the string 'unknown' when no source establishes one.

benefitSharingRecord.description: The id of the benefit-sharing register record this row enters under, or null when none exists yet. Null is required, never optional, when identity.issuer names an actual holder (anything other than 'unknown').

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 date this row's facts were assembled.
